findings.title: Potential SQL Injection (SQL String Concatenation)
findings.description: SQL query built by concatenating a variable into the query string
findings.snippet: var query = "SELECT name,id FROM Users WHERE login='" + req.body.login + "'";
context: ✓ String concatenation in SQL query detected
⚠ No parameterized query visible
✓ User input (req.*) used directly in query
⚠ Inside a route handler (reachable over HTTP)
findings.remediation: Use a parameterized query so the driver handles escaping: db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [userId])  // instead of '... WHERE id = ' + userId. For dynamic identifiers (table/column names), validate against an allowlist.

findings.title: Potential XSS (DOM innerHTML Assignment)
findings.description: Value is parsed as HTML by the browser, so any markup or script in it runs
context: ✓ Value assigned to innerHTML/outerHTML
⚠ No HTML encoding or sanitization visible
? Value source unclear (API or database data → possible stored XSS)
⚠ Runs in the browser (DOM-based XSS)
findings.remediation: Insert text, not HTML: el.textContent = value  // instead of el.innerHTML = value. If HTML is required, sanitize it first: el.innerHTML = DOMPurify.sanitize(value).

findings.title: Potential XSS (Unescaped Template Output)
findings.description: Template renders the value as raw HTML instead of escaping it
context: ✓ Template outputs a value without HTML escaping
⚠ No HTML encoding or sanitization visible
? Value source unclear (API or database data → possible stored XSS)
? Template — check which route renders it and with what data
findings.remediation: Use the escaping form of the template tag: <%= value %> instead of <%- value %> (EJS), {{ value }} instead of {{{ value }}} (Handlebars), #{value} instead of !{value} (Pug), {{ value }} instead of v-html (Vue).
